canonical_project: Telangana Data Centre City (Aloor, Chevella mandal)
notes: India's first dedicated data centre city planned on 1,500 acres at Aloor village, Chevella mandal (Rangareddy district), ~55 km from Hyderabad; state providing water, power (open access) and connectivity; treated-water supply PPP under consideration. Telangana has ~150-200 MW operational DC capacity and ~5 GW of projects in the pipeline.
